title: The Stone Castles - A kővárak
grammar: Defensive fortifications & condition: kővárat épít, védelmet nyújt, ellenáll

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain why stone castles succeeded against the Mongols where earthworks failed.
I can name key fortifications founded by IV. Béla (Buda Castle, Visegrád).
I can explain the outcome of the 1285 second Tatar invasion.
I can use defense collocations (kővárat épít, védelmet nyújt, ellenáll).
